scientific_question: Does the model-wide basis fail only because the residual-output gauge drifts with depth, so that three fixed contiguous depth-group bases can remove sharing regret at the identical 200x total state budget?

theory_reconciliation.parent_positive: One rank-545 model-wide basis plus 1,536 coordinates per c_proj reached 0.9113 mean and 0.8964 minimum recovery at 200.076x, with 0.9253 independent-basis overlap.
theory_reconciliation.binding_failure: The parent was rejected only because early/middle layers lost as much as 0.0787 versus their same-rank local oracle, beyond the frozen 0.05 sharing-regret limit. The regret decreased toward layer 11, identifying depth-dependent gauge drift.
theory_reconciliation.single_discriminator: Use exactly three contiguous groups [0--3], [4--7], [8--11]. Keep the parent total rank 545, per-matrix state 1,536, and total coordinate count 566,016 unchanged. This changes sharing topology without changing state.
theory_reconciliation.allocation: Each calibration bank independently allocates the 545 ranks across the three groups. Every group first receives rank 64; remaining ranks select the largest normalized marginal eigenvalues across group spectra. Normalization gives each depth group equal total weight and the descending spectrum makes the allocation prefix-valid.
theory_reconciliation.fresh_evaluation: The old discovery A/B banks are calibration only. All binding recovery gates are scored on fresh seed 20260924 and fresh heldout seed 20260925, neither used by prior structure selection.
theory_reconciliation.optimism: Projection coefficients remain oracle values. A pass establishes depth-grouped output-frame shareability only, not a causal coefficient generator.
theory_reconciliation.no_sweep: No alternative grouping, group count, total rank, minimum rank, state split, seed, or topology is authorized if this test fails.

functional_protocol.score: Exact terminal c_proj minus exact reproducible step-zero c_proj, applied to terminal same-run routing and c_fc activations in all layers.
functional_protocol.anti_leakage: Group allocation and bases observe only one old calibration bank. Binding scores use only fresh evaluation_c and heldout banks; neither updates allocation, basis, grouping, or state.

analysis.allocation_objective: maximize the sum of group-normalized captured energy after the fixed rank-64 floor

decision_rule.pass: Both independently calibrated grouped frames must jointly pass every gate on evaluation_c and heldout. A pass authorizes only a fixed-operator coefficient-generation oracle at this exact grouping, allocation rule, and state budget.
decision_rule.fail: A failure rejects the three-group remedy. Do not sweep groups or ranks; choose between an explicit residual-write exception and relaxing the global compression target.
decision_rule.allocation_stability: The L1 difference between independent rank allocations is reported descriptively but is not a post-hoc gate.

scope_caveat: This is an endpoint-selected, zero-update output-frame upper bound with oracle coefficients. It does not establish causal coefficient generation, optimizer reachability, or language-model loss closure.
